findings.evidence: The section variables at line 187 impose `[CharZero k]`, while roadmap `Suggested.lean:185-214` specifies the Layer 4 criterion over an algebraically closed field with `char k ∤ |G|`; Mathlib's `FDRep.simple_iff_end_is_rank_one` itself only requires `[NeZero (Nat.card G : k)]` (`FinGroupCharZero.lean:90`).
findings.fix: State the three criteria under `[NeZero (Nat.card G : k)]` (or equivalent invertibility) and derive the natural-number decomposition categorically from Mackey/Frobenius reciprocity rather than cancelling casts in `k`.
findings.issue: `simple_indFDRep_iff` and its elementwise/subsingleton variants at lines 259 and 274 inherit `[CharZero k]`, excluding algebraically closed positive-characteristic fields even when `char k ∤ |G|`.

summary: The criterion is stated only in characteristic zero, stronger than the natural nonmodular hypothesis required by the roadmap.
